correctness.rationale: For labelled simple cycles n>=5, L dominates iff no cyclic 000; D dominates iff no 111; two distinct D vertices have equal nonempty L-neighbour signatures exactly when 00100 occurs. A weighted 16-state de Bruijn matrix encodes these constraints, and its characteristic polynomial yields the rational log-derivative counting polynomial with denominator 1-zu^2-z^2u^3-z^2u^4-z^2u^5-z^3u^6, recurrence and bounds. Independent direct graph-neighbourhood exhaustive enumeration n=5..10 reproduces all six initial polynomials, including n=6:14z^3+3z^4.
